Description: Cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback -> OrionTV.Desktop.App. MainWindow creates PlayerView, PlayerView uses MpvLocalEngine and MpvHost, and MpvLocalEngine uses the PlaybackState enum declared in OrionTV.Desktop.App.

Cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Controls -> OrionTV.Desktop.App. MainWindow creates the views, the views use CardGrid and PageHeader, and VideoCardControl calls ImageLoader in OrionTV.Desktop.App.
OrionTV.Desktop.App has I = 0.25 (Ce=1: Views; Ca=3: Views, Controls, LocalPlayback). It depends on the much less stable OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views, which has I = 0.8 (Ce=4, Ca=1).

Description: Diagnostic file logging is implemented separately in OrionTV.Desktop.App (VodCacheLog) and OrionTV.Desktop.App.LiveTranslation (LiveTranslationLog). Each writes its own log file under LocalApplicationData, and each component also carries its own main concern (VOD caching, live translation).

Locating external executables on PATH or in well-known folders is implemented separately in OrionTV.Desktop.App (AiCliLauncher.ResolveCommand/FindOnPath) and OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback (MpvLocalEngine.FindMpvExecutable, PotPlayerLauncher.ResolveExecutable). Both components are otherwise responsible for other concerns (AI import, local playback).

The test project is a single namespace with about 27 top-level test classes and about 20 nested helpers (stub handlers, fake HLS server, progress helpers), covering every part of Core and App. It amounts to several thousand lines.

OrionTV.Desktop.Tests contains independent groups of test classes that do not use each other: VOD protocol/catalog tests, live channel health tests, translation protocol tests, VOD cache/download tests, local media tests, player/navigation UI tests, update service tests and AI CLI tests.
